messages:
melissa: Quick sync — Ceres trial (US-West) integration checklist before Tue demo. Who owns: VPC peering, SSO (SAML), model pin + quant variant, and sample test data? Need ETA for each and any blockers on Dedicated capacity request.

raj: I can own VPC peering (peering + routes). Current step: waiting on Ceres network team to approve CIDR. ETA EOD Mon if they approve today. Blocking item: they asked for BGP details — asked for contact.

alex: SSO/SAML on our side — IdP config done, need Ceres metadata. @melissa who is the Ceres SSO contact? PR for SSO test harness: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/342 — needs review. If we get metadata I can validate in staging in ~4h.

devon: Model pinning done on our end — uploaded pinned model `v1.3-quant` to registry. Need to reserve Dedicated slot for trial — raised infra ticket INF-821. If infra approves, we can deploy a canary by Tue morning. Deploy PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/347

priya: Sample data is prepared (anonymized) and ingestion script ready. Script to run: ```bash
./ingest.sh --env=staging --file=ceres_sample.ndjson
``` Will run after peering + SSO are green. ETA ~2h after those are done.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: INF-821 has been assigned to oncall-infra. Current status: pending approval.

melissa: Great — action items: @raj get CIDR + BGP contact by EOD; @alex request metadata from Ceres and ping me if blocked; @devon follow up with infra about INF-821 and post approval ETA; @priya stand by to run ingest. If any blocker, escalate here. :thumbsup:

raj: Pinging Ceres network lead (sarah@ceres.com) now and cc'ing the ticket.

alex: Sent metadata request and copied @melissa. If no reply by 10am PT I'll escalate to AM lead.

devon: Following up INF-821 — infra asked for expected QPS and GPU type. Replying now: expected 10 rps sustained, p50 < 150ms, prefer A100 if available.

melissa: Noted. I'll try to confirm GPU preference with the customer. Small ask — add a smoke test asserting response tokens < 512 for the demo. @devon can you add that to the deploy PR?

devon: Yep, adding smoke test now. Will ping when merged.

alex: Reviewed PR #342, left a couple comments (minor). Quick ping for @devon on model name config change.

devon: Merged deploy PR and smoke test. CI green. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/commit/abc123 :party:

melissa: Awesome. Last check — who owns the demo runbook?

priya: I'll own the runbook and post steps in #all-hands-demo tomorrow. Will include rollback, smoke test steps, and contact list.

melissa: Perfect — I'll consolidate and send to Ceres after runbook is posted. If anything slips we can call a quick sync. Thanks all!
